title: Height and L² height bounds from a net near an affine plane (Simon Ch. 5, proof of Lemma 2.5, (6) and conclusion)
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (S : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (F : Finset (Euclid P)) (ξ x₀ : Euclid P) (r s L : ℝ), (∀ x ∈ μ.support ∩ closedBall ξ r, ∃ y ∈ F, dist x y ≤ s) → (∀ y ∈ F, ‖(y - x₀) - S.starProjection (y - x₀)‖ ≤ L) → dist x₀ ξ ≤ s → (∀ x ∈ μ.support ∩ closedBall ξ r, ‖(x - ξ) - S.starProjection (x - ξ)‖ ≤ 2 * s + L) ∧ ∫⁻ x in closedBall ξ r, ENNReal.ofReal (‖(x - ξ) - S.starProjection (x - ξ)‖ ^ 2) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * s + L) ^ 2) * μ (closedBall ξ r)
